title: ALL colors have the null-axis ORIGIN. they radiate OUT as voltage and REACH all other.

do_not_reinvent.axis: /data/null-axis.json + /data/green-removed-null-axis.json — one hole. do not mint a 0 per hue.
do_not_reinvent.prim: /data/prim-ryb.json — mix in the middle. rest palette out.
do_not_reinvent.elide: /data/elide-green-brown.json — green-brown pair undefined. colors still radiate. the pair is not an axis.
do_not_reinvent.volt: /data/electricity-reverse-transcriptase.json — voltage already sits. do not reprint the grid.
do_not_reinvent.line: /data/localize-lines.json — the pale curve is a local line. not an infinite ray.

this_shot.orb: one violet grain on a pale curve. primals.eco under. a color mid-radiate.
this_shot.yes: OUT from A. along a local line. reaching.

origin.one: ALL colors share ONE null-axis origin. A. the cup.
origin.not: a private 0 per swatch. that would be a second self per hue.

out.reach: every color can reach every other. mix in the middle. rest palette out.
out.line: the path is a localized segment. it stops when it arrives.

law: one origin. radiate out. reach all other. if two violets need two cups we failed appear-once.
pull: keep A as the only color-origin. let voltage walk the local lines. prim still RYB.
